server.name: server
server.help: Primary RADIUS server CN domain name or IP address.

secret.name: secret
secret.help: Pre-shared secret key used to access the primary RADIUS server.

secondary-server.name: secondary-server
secondary-server.help: Secondary RADIUS CN domain name or IP address.

secondary-secret.name: secondary-secret
secondary-secret.help: Secret key to access the secondary server.

tertiary-server.name: tertiary-server
tertiary-server.help: Tertiary RADIUS CN domain name or IP address.

tertiary-secret.name: tertiary-secret
tertiary-secret.help: Secret key to access the tertiary server.

timeout.name: timeout
timeout.help: Time in seconds to retry connecting server.

status-ttl.name: status-ttl
status-ttl.help: Time for which server reachability is cached so that when a server is unreachable, it will not be retried for at least this period of time (0 = cache disabled, default = 300).

all-usergroup.name: all-usergroup
all-usergroup.help: Enable/disable automatically including this RADIUS server in all user groups.

options.name: disable
options.help: Do not automatically include this server in a user group.

options.name: enable
options.help: Include this RADIUS server in every user group.

use-management-vdom.name: use-management-vdom
use-management-vdom.help: Enable/disable using management VDOM to send requests.

options.name: enable
options.help: Send requests using the management VDOM.

options.name: disable
options.help: Send requests using the current VDOM.

switch-controller-nas-ip-dynamic.name: switch-controller-nas-ip-dynamic
switch-controller-nas-ip-dynamic.help: Enable/Disable switch-controller nas-ip dynamic to dynamically set nas-ip.

nas-ip.name: nas-ip
nas-ip.help: IP address used to communicate with the RADIUS server and used as NAS-IP-Address and Called-Station-ID attributes.

options.name: legacy
options.help: NAS-ID value is the value previously used by each daemon.

options.name: hostname
options.help: NAS-ID value is hostname or HA group name if applicable.

call-station-id-type.name: call-station-id-type
call-station-id-type.help: Calling & Called station identifier type configuration (default = legacy), this option is not available for 802.1x authentication.

options.name: legacy
options.help: Calling & Called station identifier is the value previously used by each daemon.

options.name: IP
options.help: Calling & Called station identifier is the value of IP address.

options.name: MAC
options.help: Calling & Called station identifier is the value of MAC address.

acct-interim-interval.name: acct-interim-interval
acct-interim-interval.help: Time in seconds between each accounting interim update message.

radius-coa.name: radius-coa
radius-coa.help: Enable to allow a mechanism to change the attributes of an authentication, authorization, and accounting session after it is authenticated.

h3c-compatibility.name: h3c-compatibility
h3c-compatibility.help: Enable/disable compatibility with the H3C, a mechanism that performs security checking for authentication.

auth-type.name: auth-type
auth-type.help: Authentication methods/protocols permitted for this RADIUS server.

options.name: auto
options.help: Use PAP, MSCHAP_v2, and CHAP (in that order).

options.name: ms_chap_v2
options.help: Microsoft Challenge Handshake Authentication Protocol version 2.

source-ip.name: source-ip
source-ip.help: Source IP address for communications to the RADIUS server.

group-override-attr-type.name: group-override-attr-type
group-override-attr-type.help: RADIUS attribute type to override user group information.

require-message-authenticator.name: require-message-authenticator
require-message-authenticator.help: Require message authenticator in authentication response.

options.name: enable
options.help: Make the validation of message authenticator mandatory in authentication response.

options.name: disable
options.help: Make the validation of message authenticator optional in authentication response.

options.name: hyphen
options.help: Use hyphen as delimiter for MAC authentication username.

options.name: single-hyphen
options.help: Use single hyphen as delimiter for MAC authentication username.

options.name: colon
options.help: Use colon as delimiter for MAC authentication username.

options.name: none
options.help: No delimiter for MAC authentication username.

options.name: hyphen
options.help: Use hyphen as delimiter for MAC authentication password.

options.name: single-hyphen
options.help: Use single hyphen as delimiter for MAC authentication password.

options.name: colon
options.help: Use colon as delimiter for MAC authentication password.

options.name: none
options.help: No delimiter for MAC authentication password.

acct-all-servers.name: acct-all-servers
acct-all-servers.help: Enable/disable sending of accounting messages to all configured servers (default = disable).

options.name: enable
options.help: Send accounting messages to all configured servers.

options.name: disable
options.help: Send accounting message only to servers that are confirmed to be reachable.

switch-controller-acct-fast-framedip-det.name: switch-controller-acct-fast-framedip-detect
switch-controller-acct-fast-framedip-det.help: Switch controller accounting message Framed-IP detection from DHCP snooping (seconds, default=2).

interface-select-method.name: interface-select-method
interface-select-method.help: Specify how to select outgoing interface to reach server.

options.name: sdwan
options.help: Set outgoing interface by SD-WAN or policy routing rules.

interface.name: interface
interface.help: Specify outgoing interface to reach server.

options.name: login
options.help: User should be connected to a host.

options.name: callback-framed
options.help: User disconnected and called back, then a Framed Protocol.

options.name: outbound
options.help: User granted access to outgoing devices.

options.name: administrative
options.help: User granted access to the administrative unsigned interface.

options.name: nas-prompt
options.help: User provided a command prompt on the NAS.

options.name: authenticate-only
options.help: Authentication requested, and no auth info needs to be returned.

options.name: callback-nas-prompt
options.help: User disconnected and called back, then provided a command prompt.

options.name: call-check
options.help: Used by the NAS in an Access-Request packet, Access-Accept to answer the call.

options.name: callback-administrative
options.help: User disconnected and called back, granted access to the admin unsigned interface.

transport-protocol.name: transport-protocol
transport-protocol.help: Transport protocol to be used (default = udp).

tls-min-proto-version.name: tls-min-proto-version
tls-min-proto-version.help: Minimum supported protocol version for TLS connections (default is to follow system global setting).

ca-cert.name: ca-cert
ca-cert.help: CA of server to trust under TLS.

client-cert.name: client-cert
client-cert.help: Client certificate to use under TLS.

server-identity-check.name: server-identity-check
server-identity-check.help: Enable/disable RADIUS server identity check (verify server domain name/IP address against the server certificate).

account-key-processing.name: account-key-processing
account-key-processing.help: Account key processing operation. The FortiGate will keep either the whole domain or strip the domain from the subject identity.

options.name: strip
options.help: Strip domain string from subject identity field.

account-key-cert-field.name: account-key-cert-field
account-key-cert-field.help: Define subject identity field in certificate for user access right checking.

rsso.name: rsso
rsso.help: Enable/disable RADIUS based single sign on feature.

options.name: enable
options.help: Enable RADIUS based single sign on feature.

options.name: disable
options.help: Disable RADIUS based single sign on feature.

rsso-radius-server-port.name: rsso-radius-server-port
rsso-radius-server-port.help: UDP port to listen on for RADIUS Start and Stop records.

rsso-radius-response.name: rsso-radius-response
rsso-radius-response.help: Enable/disable sending RADIUS response packets after receiving Start and Stop records.

rsso-validate-request-secret.name: rsso-validate-request-secret
rsso-validate-request-secret.help: Enable/disable validating the RADIUS request shared secret in the Start or End record.

options.name: enable
options.help: Enable validating RADIUS request shared secret.

options.name: disable
options.help: Disable validating RADIUS request shared secret.

rsso-secret.name: rsso-secret
rsso-secret.help: RADIUS secret used by the RADIUS accounting server.

rsso-endpoint-attribute.name: rsso-endpoint-attribute
rsso-endpoint-attribute.help: RADIUS attributes used to extract the user end point identifier from the RADIUS Start record.

rsso-endpoint-block-attribute.name: rsso-endpoint-block-attribute
rsso-endpoint-block-attribute.help: RADIUS attributes used to block a user.

sso-attribute.name: sso-attribute
sso-attribute.help: RADIUS attribute that contains the profile group name to be extracted from the RADIUS Start record.

sso-attribute-key.name: sso-attribute-key
sso-attribute-key.help: Key prefix for SSO group value in the SSO attribute.

sso-attribute-value-override.name: sso-attribute-value-override
sso-attribute-value-override.help: Enable/disable override old attribute value with new value for the same endpoint.

options.name: enable
options.help: Enable override old attribute value with new value for the same endpoint.

options.name: disable
options.help: Disable override old attribute value with new value for the same endpoint.

rsso-context-timeout.name: rsso-context-timeout
rsso-context-timeout.help: Time in seconds before the logged out user is removed from the "user context list" of logged on users.

rsso-log-period.name: rsso-log-period
rsso-log-period.help: Time interval in seconds that group event log messages will be generated for dynamic profile events.

rsso-log-flags.name: rsso-log-flags
rsso-log-flags.default: protocol-error profile-missing accounting-stop-missed accounting-event endpoint-block radiusd-other

rsso-flush-ip-session.name: rsso-flush-ip-session
rsso-flush-ip-session.help: Enable/disable flushing user IP sessions on RADIUS accounting Stop messages.

options.name: enable
options.help: Enable flush user IP sessions on RADIUS accounting stop.

options.name: disable
options.help: Disable flush user IP sessions on RADIUS accounting stop.

rsso-ep-one-ip-only.name: rsso-ep-one-ip-only
rsso-ep-one-ip-only.help: Enable/disable the replacement of old IP addresses with new ones for the same endpoint on RADIUS accounting Start messages.

options.name: enable
options.help: Enable replacement of old IP address with new IP address for the same endpoint on RADIUS accounting start.

options.name: disable
options.help: Disable replacement of old IP address with new IP address for the same endpoint on RADIUS accounting start.

delimiter.name: delimiter
delimiter.help: Configure delimiter to be used for separating profile group names in the SSO attribute (default = plus character "+").

options.name: disable
options.help: Do not log to remote syslog server.

server.name: server
server.help: Server CN domain name or IP address.

source-ip.name: source-ip
source-ip.help: Source IP address for communications to the RADIUS server.

interface-select-method.name: interface-select-method
interface-select-method.help: Specify how to select outgoing interface to reach server.

options.name: sdwan
options.help: Set outgoing interface by SD-WAN or policy routing rules.

interface.name: interface
interface.help: Specify outgoing interface to reach server.
